items.context: @intangiblecoins (Alex Thorn, 63.424 seguidores), en inglés: «bitcoin bear market comparisons» con gráfico de Galaxy Research «Four Bear Markets Against Their 50-Week And 200-Week Averages: This One Has Been The Shallowest»: 2013-15 -85% (5 cierres semanales bajo la de 200 semanas), 2017-18 -84% (1), 2021-22 -77% (47, la más profunda -32%), 2025-26 -53% hasta ahora (5, la más profunda -10%). Post de ~28 min con 38 likes, 5 reposts, 6 respuestas, 8 guardados y 3.051 vistas (creciendo). Ángulo: caídas cada vez menos profundas por ciclo (Cycle Clock).
items.suggested_text:
What stands out to me is the trend across cycles, not just this one. Peak-to-trough went -85%, -84%, -77% and, so far, -53%: each bear shallower than the last, a pattern usually tied to a bigger, more liquid market with a different holder base.

The 200-week line tells a similar story. 2013-15 spent only 5 weekly closes below it and 2017-18 just 1, then 2021-22 spent 47 and went 32% under. This cycle has 5 closes below so far, the deepest at -10%.

Shallower drawdowns can mean less forced selling, or simply that the flush isn't finished. Which one this is only shows up in hindsight, and the right panel still has a lot of empty weeks.
